title: projects
summary: Root project row; RLS owner by user_id. Insert trigger creates Main branch and sets active_branch_id. 4 columns from later migrations (aspect_ratio, continuity_mode, style capsule FKs); rag columns dropped in 004. writing/visual_style_capsule_id are read-only in code.
notes: project_type 'audio-visual' from frontend violates CHECK. visual_style_capsule_id never written. Full detail in C-table-inventory.md section 1.

title: branches
summary: Git-style branches per project. Rows are created only by the create_initial_branch trigger; code only reads them. No DELETE RLS policy. name and commit_message are reachable only via a to-one embed that the code reads as an array.
notes: parent_branch_id UNREF. No updated_at column.

title: stage_states
summary: Versioned JSON content per branch and stage 1-12 (code writes 1-5); every status change inserts a new version. Has status incl. skipped, and origin (041). mig-044 BEFORE INSERT trigger enforces stage lock prerequisites on all inserts. No updated_at, no DELETE policy.
notes: frames.ts reads nonexistent state_data/project_id columns. prompt_template_version, final_prompt, langsmith_trace_id runtime-unused.

title: prompt_templates
summary: Versioned LLM prompt templates (name+version unique) used at runtime by /api/llm/generate-from-template for stages 2-4. SELECT policy exposes is_active rows to every role (no TO clause).
notes: Runtime use verified by read of call sites; prompt body text not analysed (V2).

title: style_capsule_libraries
summary: Libraries grouping style capsules; presets have user_id NULL and is_preset TRUE and are readable by every role. Owner-only writes. Trigger keeps updated_at.
notes: All 7 columns referenced.

title: style_capsules
summary: Writing and visual style capsules with typed arrays and design_pillars JSON. UNIQUE(library_id,name) from 004 plus a broken partial-unique intent from 005 (invalid DDL). Reference image URLs stored as text[]; removing an image does not delete the object.
notes: All 16 columns referenced.

title: style_capsule_applications
summary: Audit log of style capsule applied to a stage state. Only written from the stage-state PUT route; the service method that would write applied_at is never called; nothing reads the table.
notes: Write-only audit. Frontend calls a nonexistent service method (TypeError caught).

title: global_assets
summary: User-owned reusable assets (library). asset_type CHECK now includes extra_archetype but the API accepts only 3 types. voice_profile_id and promoted_from_project_id are write-only. version incremented in code non-atomically.
notes: Delete blocked by API if any project_assets reference it.

title: project_assets
summary: Per-project assets (character, prop, location, extra_archetype) with locked/deferred/source/style_outdated flags, sync tracking, scene_numbers and location_aliases JSON. Heaviest-used asset table. description NOT NULL but an empty description can be written as NULL. locked gates only some operations.
notes: last_synced_at and updated_at write-only; cloned source never written.

title: project_asset_generation_attempts
summary: Carousel of generated or uploaded images per project asset; cap 4 with non-atomic deselect-then-select of is_selected. Three upload metadata columns are write-only.
notes: Cap is 4 here vs 8 in scene_asset_generation_attempts.

title: asset_angle_variants
summary: Multi-angle reference images (front, side, three_quarter, back) per project asset, unique per angle. prompt_snapshot and image_generation_job_id are write-only. Reads do not filter by status.
notes: Trigger reuses generic update_updated_at_column defined in this file.

title: location_views
summary: Views (establishing and direction) of a location asset with camera metadata, promoted-from-frame and established-from-shot pointers. established_from_shot_id has no FK. Camera fields copied from shots without a CHECK on the source.
notes: established_from_scene, established_from_shot_id, updated_at, promoted_from_frame_id write-only.

title: location_match_events
summary: Audit log of shot-to-location resolver decisions. Written only; nothing in backend, frontend or scripts reads it. Cascades on shot delete.
notes: Write-only calibration log; no reader found.

title: scenes
summary: Scenes per branch with status CHECK, cached extraction fields, shot-list lock timestamp with status-sync trigger, is_deferred, and end_frame placeholder with no FK. stage_locks JSON is used by code but created only by quickies SQL outside the migration chain.
notes: end_frame_id UNREF. Scene status only ever set to shot_list_ready, draft, video_complete in code.

title: shots
summary: Shots per scene (UNIQUE scene_id+shot_id) carrying prompts, continuity fields, camera metadata, location identity, reference-image JSON, and selected continuity base. Extraction inserts with no delete or guard; shot delete cascades frames, jobs, assignments, transformation events.
notes: Camera fields have no CHECK. No delete-before-insert on re-extraction.

title: frames
summary: Start and end frame images per shot with status CHECK and lineage columns (generated_from, continuity_base_role, promoted_to_view). Code writes status 'invalidated' which the CHECK rejects and the error is ignored. No direct DELETE route; rows removed only by cascade.
notes: frames.ts:1465 deletes storage from wrong bucket (C-FACT-15).

title: frame_links
summary: Links between frames: match (reactive) or reference; one link per target frame after 035. Created by code (12 .from references). No updated_at.
notes: Reactive propagation logic not traced in this slice.

title: image_generation_jobs
summary: Job table for all image generation kinds (7 job_type values). Only a SELECT RLS policy exists, so user JWTs cannot write. retry_count is never referenced; several timestamps are write-only. No updated_at trigger.
notes: Backend writes via service role so the missing write policies do not block it.

title: video_generation_jobs
summary: Veo video generation jobs queued from confirmed shots with frame snapshots, cost estimate and actual, and provider fields. Has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE RLS, no DELETE. queued_at is default-only.
notes: Unlock cost estimate counts videos via nonexistent videos table (C-FACT-11).

title: scene_asset_instances
summary: Scene-specific state per (scene, project asset): override text, image, status tags, carry_forward, inheritance pointer, effective_description (stored, not synced), audit counters maintained by trigger, master-reference selection fields. selected_master_reference_source and _instance_id are write-only.
notes: modification_count and last_modified_field read only by frontend.

title: scene_asset_generation_attempts
summary: Carousel of generated, uploaded or master-copied images per scene asset instance, cap 8, non-atomic is_selected handling. Several metadata columns are write-only.
notes: copied_from_url, image_generation_job_id, file_size_bytes, mime_type write-only.

title: scene_asset_suggestions
summary: AI-suggested assets per scene, persisted so they survive refresh. asset_type CHECK excludes extra_archetype while the LLM value is unvalidated. No updated_at trigger; asset_id never written.
notes: Single FOR ALL policy.

title: transformation_events
summary: Within-scene asset transformations tied to a trigger shot (cascade) and optional completion shot (SET NULL). Create route never sets pre/post image keys; only manual detection is written by code. Gradual events disabled when completion shot is deleted.
notes: pre_status_tags never read; confirmed_at write-only.

title: shot_asset_assignments
summary: Per-shot assignment of scene asset instances with presence_type. Bulk delete and re-insert per scene via deleteAllForScene and autoPopulate. updated_at trigger only.
notes: Shot merge does not re-clone assignments.

title: text_field_versions
summary: Versioned text for shot prompts and scene-asset description overrides (polymorphic entity_id, no FK, cap 8). RLS is USING true WITH CHECK true with no TO clause, so every role including anon can read and write all rows.
notes: source column taken from request body unvalidated.

title: user_credits
summary: Per-user credit balance (default 100) used for video generation billing. last_topup_at is effectively never written because addCredits has no caller. No DELETE policy.
notes: Checkout route references credits; top-up path not traced.

title: intake_resolutions
summary: Facts ledger for Streamline intake questions, written only by the streamline_commit RPC; read in one place (contextManager) for four columns. Five columns are never read.
notes: Only SELECT and INSERT RLS policies.

title: intake_resolution_edits
summary: Reconciliation audit rows linked to intake resolutions, written only by the RPC. Never read by TypeScript. Frontend always sends target_type stage and never a stage number.
notes: Write-only audit, no reader.

title: videos (referenced, not created)
summary: Code queries and updates a table named videos for the shot-list unlock cost estimate and invalidation, but no migration creates it. Errors are not destructured, so the result is always empty.
notes: Video assets are stored in Storage bucket videos, not in a table of that name.

title: invalidation_logs (referenced, not created)
summary: Insert target for an unlock audit log; no DDL exists. Insert is wrapped in try/catch but supabase-js returns an error object, so the failure is silent.

title: users (referenced in script only, not created)
summary: A scripts-only query on a public.users table. Only auth.users exists in the migrations. Script, not app runtime.
notes: V2 script territory.

title: hello (referenced in test only)
summary: A test-only table name. No DDL. Not app runtime.

title: frames.ts reads nonexistent stage_states columns, so visual style capsule is never applied in five frame paths
summary: frames.ts selects state_data by project_id and stage_number from stage_states, which has neither state_data nor project_id. The error is not checked, so visualStyleCapsuleId is always undefined in five generate/regenerate/inpaint paths.
notes: Inferred from code and schema; not run.

title: Migration 005 has an invalid partial UNIQUE constraint, so the intended per-user name uniqueness does not exist
summary: ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT ... UNIQUE (user_id, name) WHERE library_id IS NULL is not valid PostgreSQL syntax. Statements before it apply under per-statement execution; this one errors; its comment claims the constraint exists.
notes: Grammar claim is from PostgreSQL syntax, not run.

title: scenes.stage_locks is used by code but exists only in quickies SQL outside the migration chain
summary: Six non-test files read or write scenes.stage_locks. No file in backend/migrations creates it; quickies/add_stage_locks.sql adds it with a comment saying it ran on prod. A database built from the chain lacks the column.
notes: Frontend ProjectView.tsx:519 and Stage7ShotList.tsx:700 also reference stage locks through the API.

title: Shot-list unlock writes frames.status 'invalidated' which violates the CHECK; error ignored
summary: projects.ts updates frames.status to invalidated. frames.status CHECK is pending|generating|generated|approved|rejected, so the update fails without being checked, and the frames are not invalidated.
notes: Response still reports framesAffected from a separate count.

title: testConnection queries a nonexistent projects.count column and the migration runner cannot run as written
summary: DatabaseService.testConnection selects count from projects. The migration runner splits SQL on semicolons and sends each fragment to an exec RPC that no migration defines. Both paths make repo-driven migration runs unusable.
notes: Inferred: testConnection returns false. Not run.

title: text_field_versions has an RLS policy open to every role including anon
summary: Single FOR ALL policy with USING true and WITH CHECK true and no TO clause applies to anon and authenticated. Comment says ownership is enforced in the API layer. No frontend direct access found.
notes: Exposure through PostgREST with the anon key depends on live API exposure, not run.

title: Project type 'audio-visual' from frontend violates the DB CHECK and blocks saving the project type
summary: DB and backend use audio_visual. Frontend sends audio-visual. PUT returns 400 and the streamline commit's UPDATE violates the CHECK, rolling back the whole commit, so the option cannot be saved either way.
notes: Rejection path inferred from code; not run.

title: storyContextService reads stage content keys no writer produces, so the treatment section is always empty
summary: Reads Stage 3 treatmentProse and Stage 2 treatments or selectedTreatmentId. Writers store Stage 2 as variations and activeVariation, and Stage 3 has no treatmentProse key.

title: Branch name embed is read as an array, so the branch is always reported as main
summary: The to-one embed branches!active_branch_id returns an object, and the code reads it with [0], which is undefined. The fallback main is always returned instead of the real Main branch name.
notes: Display-only impact.

title: Migration runner splits SQL on semicolons and sends fragments to an undefined exec RPC
summary: runMigration splits file text on semicolon, breaking dollar-quoted function bodies in about 12 migrations. It sends each fragment to supabase.rpc('exec'), which no repo file defines. Prod build method is unknown.

title: Shot-list unlock reads nonexistent videos table and logs to nonexistent invalidation_logs, so video counts are zero and logging is silent
summary: projects.ts and sceneStageLocks read videos (no DDL), so the select returns no data and the video update is a no-op. The invalidation_logs insert returns an error object that is not thrown, so the failure is silent.
notes: Cost estimate excludes video regeneration cost.

title: Attempt caps differ (8 for scene assets, 4 for project assets, 8 for text versions) and enforcement is check-then-delete without a transaction
summary: Each cap deletes at most one oldest non-selected row per call. is_selected uniqueness is maintained by deselect-then-insert or select with no transaction, leaving a window with no selected row and a race on the partial unique index.
notes: Race behaviour not run.

title: mig-044 stage-lock trigger applies to every stage_states insert and can reject backfill and PUT inserts with no pre-check
summary: BEFORE INSERT trigger requires stage N-1 latest version locked or skipped for locked inserts at stage>1. Streamline backfill and stageStates PUT do not check N-1, so these inserts can fail with 500 after an LLM call.
notes: Trigger rejection path inferred from SQL; not run.

title: stage_states.origin is dropped to NULL by several writers
summary: Lock, unlock-to-draft, outdated cascade, and PUT without origin do not copy origin forward, so streamline imported or authored provenance is lost after one edit or re-lock.
notes: Field present in schema from 041.

title: Frame attempt delete removes storage from bucket frames, which is never created or written to, while the object lives in asset-images
summary: frames.ts removes job.storage_path from the frames bucket. Job storage_path is written by ImageGenerationService to asset-images. The remove error is not checked, so the object is orphaned.

title: project_assets.description NOT NULL can receive NULL when an empty description is submitted
summary: Route defaults description to empty string and then inserts description || null, which turns empty string into null and violates NOT NULL. Extraction fallback can also pass undefined (reported, sampled).
notes: Runtime error inferred from constraint; not run.

title: project_assets.locked is set but gates only some operations and has no unlock path
summary: Set to true by lock routes and scene asset create. Set to false only at insert. Gates PUT, delete, merge, split, and sync. Not gating image upload, generation, edit, clear images, attempts, angle variants, location views, clone or promote. Frontend does not read it.

title: Location view camera fields are copied from shots, which have no CHECK, into columns that do have CHECK
summary: establish-from-frame copies shot camera_distance and camera_height into location_views. Shot columns have no check and the shot PUT accepts any string, so the copy can violate the target CHECK.

title: Shot delete cascades transformation events, assignments, location match events and jobs; text versions and established_from_shot_id are orphaned
summary: Shot deletes cascade to frames, video jobs, transformation events (trigger shot), assignments, location match events, and image jobs. completion_shot_id is SET NULL, which silently disables a gradual event. text_field_versions and location_views.established_from_shot_id have no FK.

title: Shot extraction route inserts without deleting existing shots or guarding, so a re-run collides on UNIQUE(scene_id, shot_id)
summary: POST shots/extract inserts extracted shots at projects.ts:1943 with no preceding delete and no existing-shot check in the handler. Repeated shot_id values fail the UNIQUE constraint and the route returns 500.
notes: Whether the frontend can call it twice is not traced.

title: scene_asset_instances.effective_description is stored but not synced when project asset description or overrides change
summary: Computed on create, populate, and inherit. Not recomputed by asset PUT, merge, split, or text-version write-back. Readers include the scene-asset image prompt and several prompt and context builders.

title: modification_count increments on every scene asset update, so the frontend edited flag fires on non-edit changes
summary: Trigger increments modification_count on every UPDATE, including selection and merge re-points, and the frontend treats count above zero as edited.

title: scene_asset_suggestions asset_type CHECK excludes extra_archetype and the LLM value is unvalidated, so one bad value fails the bulk insert
summary: Insert takes the LLM asset_type as z.string(), and the DB CHECK allows only character, location, prop. A bad value fails the entire batch, and the frontend swallows the error.

title: shots.reference_image_order and end_frame_reference_image_order are read and written by frame reorder routes
summary: Two JSON array columns used by frame reorder logic, with an Array.isArray guard. Element shape not traced. No defect identified.
notes: Informational.

title: Migrations 022 and 024 each have two files with the same numeric prefix; lexical order is safe because neither pair depends on the other
summary: Runner sorts filenames lexically, giving 022_add_aspect_ratio before 022_scene_asset_generation_attempts and 024_extra_archetype before 024_scene_asset_suggestions. No cross-dependency found, so order does not cause skew, but the numeric prefix is not unique.

title: storage-rls-error-work-around.md premise is not supported by code; backend uploads use the service role and the frontend makes no storage calls
summary: The doc says style-capsule-images upload fails without storage.objects policies. Code uploads only through the service-role client, which bypasses RLS on storage (platform behaviour). Solution 1 policy 2 in the doc is truncated and differs from the SQL file.
notes: Service-role bypass is external platform behaviour, not verified in repo.

title: Schema drift precedent: live code used shots.end_frame_reference_image_order before any migration created it
summary: Migration 039 notes the compatibility fix. Together with stage_locks and missing videos and invalidation_logs, code and migration chain disagree.

title: scenes.end_frame_id is an unused placeholder with no FK
summary: Column added in 003 with a comment about a future FK. The FK was never added, and no code writes or reads it.

title: style_capsule_applications is written only from the stage-state PUT route; applied_at comes from the DB default
summary: The service method that would record applied_at is never called. Frontend calls a nonexistent method with a fake stage id, which throws and is logged.

title: prompt_templates SELECT policy exposes active template rows to every role including anon
summary: Policy is USING is_active = TRUE without a TO clause. Prompt bodies are readable by any role that reaches the table over the API.
notes: Exposure depends on live API config.

title: Backend uses only the service-role client, so RLS is bypassed for all backend queries; the frontend uses anon key with user session for two direct table reads
summary: One client in backend/src/config/supabase.ts uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; no user-scoped client exists in backend. Authorization is app-level filters. Frontend direct reads are useSceneInfo (scenes) and imageService (projects), both owner-scoped by RLS. No frontend storage or rpc calls.
notes: Completeness of app-level authorization is cross-slice (auth middleware, routes).

title: Storage buckets used in code: asset-images and style-capsule-images have creation scripts; videos and frames have none
summary: setup scripts create asset-images (10 MB, public) and style-capsule-images (5 MB, public). videos is written by Veo3 provider; frames is only a remove target. Neither videos nor frames is created by any repo file.
notes: Bucket existence in live project UNKNOWN.

title: Storage path templates for asset-images are inconsistent between project/ and project_ roots, and master assets always use .png
summary: Image generation writes project_{pid}/branch_{bid}/... with underscores, uploads write project/{pid}/... with slashes, and global assets use global/{uid}/... Master_asset paths force .png; other writers keep the upload extension. Inpaint masks use upsert.
notes: Full template list in C-database.md section 4.2.

title: Storage objects are not deleted when their DB rows are removed by cascade or asset delete
summary: Project asset delete and scene asset instance delete cascade DB rows but leave objects. Style-capsule image removal clears the URL only. Attempt caps and angle-variant delete do remove objects.

title: Trigger set: updated_at BEFORE UPDATE on 15 tables; status-sync on scenes; modification counter on scene_asset_instances; stage-lock prerequisite on stage_states insert; no trigger on 12 tables with updated_at or other mutable state
summary: Most tables with an updated_at column get a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that overrides client values. projects, image_generation_jobs, scene_asset_suggestions, and text_field_versions have no trigger. branches and stage_states have no updated_at column.
notes: Full trigger table in C-database.md section 3.1.

title: streamline_commit_atomic is the only commit entry point; it wraps streamline_commit and applies stage 1 draft and project config in the same transaction
summary: Route calls streamline_commit_atomic. The wrapper applies project_config and stage_1_draft, then calls streamline_commit with those keys stripped. Serialises with FOR UPDATE on stage rows 1-5, which locks nothing when no rows exist.
notes: Streamline-specific behaviour is cross-slice.

title: Shot-list lock trigger changes only scene status; it enforces nothing on shots or frames
summary: fn_sync_scene_lock_status sets scenes.status to shot_list_ready on lock (unconditionally, overwriting downstream status) and to draft on unlock only from shot_list_ready. No trigger or FK blocks shot or frame edits while locked; any such enforcement is in route code (not traced here).
notes: Route-level lock enforcement UNKNOWN in this slice.

title: global_assets API accepts 3 asset types while the DB allows extra_archetype; promote copies the project type
summary: global_assets asset_type CHECK includes extra_archetype (024), but assets.ts create and update accept only character, prop, location. Promote from project to library copies the project asset type, which may be extra_archetype.
notes: Ledger id for report item F-29.

title: Clone path omits source, so cloned assets are stored as extracted; cloned value is never written
summary: The clone insert (projectAssets.ts:1950-1963) sets no source, so the column default extracted applies. The 023 CHECK allows cloned but no code writes it. Clone sync compares the global URL with an already-copied project URL, so every sync copies again (reported, sampled).
notes: Ledger id for report item F-30.
